question: One of the hereditary hypercoagulability states is due to the alteration of one of the following proteins, but NOT to the lack of it; which one?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Factor V Leiden -> resistance to activated protein C -> increased risk of thrombosis -> 95% confidence. CHAIN: Antithrombin -> deficiency leads to hypercoagulability -> not due to lack of it -> 90% confidence. CHAIN: Protein C -> deficiency leads to hypercoagulability -> not due to lack of it -> 85% confidence. CHAIN: Protein S -> deficiency leads to hypercoagulability -> not due to lack of it -> 95%
enhanced_information: The hereditary hypercoagulability state not due to lack of the protein is Factor V Leiden.
